name: web-angular-sw

scripts.start: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm inject && pnpm upload && pnpm verify:broken; pnpm regen && pnpm verify:fixed && pnpm serve
scripts.start:offline: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm inject && pnpm verify:broken; pnpm regen && pnpm verify:fixed && pnpm serve

description: Angular app with the Angular service worker, reproducing PostHog/posthog#86046: `ng build` records a SHA-1 of every bundle in ngsw.json, then `posthog-cli sourcemap inject` rewrites the bundles, so the service worker rejects the new version and keeps serving the cached app. `pnpm start` proves both halves: the hashes mismatch after inject and match again after `ngsw-config` regenerates the manifest.
